name: cbs_chv
title: Community-Based Surveillance: CHV Signal Detection and Reporting
description: A Community Health Volunteer detects and investigates a cluster of acute watery diarrhoea across two villages, gathers information from key informants and affected households, records findings in a CHV notebook, and reports the signal to a local-level supervisor.
clinicalInvariants: Disease pattern: cluster of acute watery diarrhoea with vomiting across two neighbouring villages within one week
Affected population: approximately 10 people (adults and children) in Village A lower area and Village C near river
Timeline: first cases Friday, signal detected Monday, three days of illness
Severity: at least one severely dehydrated elderly man (sunken eyes, not urinating, cannot stand)
Common exposures: shared open well near river (Village A), burial gathering with food and water (Village C)
No recent travel outside the area for affected households
CBS signal met: two or more persons with similar severe signs/symptoms in same community within one week
Key informant network: market vendor (Mama Asha), religious leader (Imam Karim), school teacher (Teacher Daniel)
Supervisor: Mr. Musa at health post in Village B
